title: APSONIC Innovative Products Debut at the 137th Canton Fair
excerpt: APSONIC showcased its latest engine technologies and new motorcycle models at the prestigious Canton Fair, attracting global attention. Visitors from over 50 countries showed great interest in the DuraCore™ engine technology.

content.content: The 137th China Import and Export Fair (Canton Fair) witnessed the grand launch of APSONIC's latest heavy-duty motorcycle lineup. These innovative models are carefully engineered to meet the growing demands of modern logistics and personal transit across Africa.

content.caption: The APSONIC booth at the 137th Canton Fair, presenting the newest product models

content.content: Visitors from over 50 countries visited the APSONIC pavilion, showing deep curiosity in the DuraCore™ engine technology. This innovation promises superior thermal dissipation and fuel efficiency, tailor-made for harsh African conditions.

title: APSONIC Supports Africa Cup and Côte d'Ivoire Maintenance Works
excerpt: Contributing to communities, APSONIC provided vehicles and support for urban maintenance during the Africa Cup celebrations. We partnered with local Ivorian authorities to ensure smooth operations.

content.content: APSONIC is proud to announce a strategic partnership with local Ivorian authorities to ensure smooth logistics during the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations. As part of community feedback, we donated a fleet of specialized cargo motorcycles.

content.caption: APSONIC brand displays on site during the Africa Cup celebrations

title: APSONIC Sailing Team Makes Debut in World-Class Competition
excerpt: The APSONIC Sailing Team participated in its first world-class international sailing regatta, showcasing team spirit and collaboration. This debut marks a major milestone in our brand's global journey.

content.content: APSONIC's 'Go Forward' spirit moves to the oceans as our team participated in its first world-class international regatta, proving that with unity, no horizon is too distant.

content.caption: The APSONIC Sailing Team competing at sea
